_about: What a CSA figure should show, per kind of section. Used by csa_docx/figures (need, brief, draw) and the Evidence Workspace Figures page. Generic for every project: a profile matches a section by its requirement family (the SEP-<FAMILY>-nn IDs in its requirement table) or by its key, never by section number. archetype: A system overview, B service dependency, C zones and conduits, D access path, E numbered flow, F data flow (stores and directed data flows from hosts/flows.csv and host settings; flows: the flows filter, else from_topic's), none = a table says it better. service: which relationships a B figure draws (csa_docx/figures/relations.py). built: false until that figure kind can be drawn. scope (archetype C): all | internet | transfer, which captured flows the figure keeps.

profiles.question: What the system is and how its parts connect
must_show: Both data centres with their hosts by tier
Shared services
Links to IT and the Internet
profiles.caption: System overview: hosts, sites and observed connections

profiles.question: Which systems outside the OT data centres the vital hosts depend on
must_show: Every dependency that leaves the OT data centres
Whether each is IT, Internet or OT
profiles.caption: Dependencies of the vital OT hosts on systems outside OT

profiles.question: Whether logons and service accounts depend on the enterprise directory
must_show: Domain controllers and their domain
Kerberos / LDAP use by each vital host
OT-resident directory, or its absence
profiles.caption: Directory and authentication dependencies

profiles.question: Where the vital hosts get their certificates
must_show: Issuing CA for each certificate consumer
OT-resident CA, or its absence
profiles.caption: Certificate sources for the vital OT hosts

profiles.question: Where each vital OT host gets its time
must_show: Each vital host's active time source
Whether the source is OT-resident or IT
Configured peers that are not in use
profiles.caption: Time sources of the vital OT hosts

profiles.question: Which DNS resolvers each vital OT host uses
must_show: Each vital host's configured DNS servers, in order
Whether each resolver is OT-resident or IT
Resolvers the evidence does not name
profiles.caption: DNS resolvers used by the vital OT hosts

profiles.question: Zones, conduits between them, and whether the boundaries are enforced
must_show: Zones and sites
Cross-zone and cross-site flows
Boundary devices, or a marker where none is evidenced
Conduits to external networks
profiles.caption: Zones and conduits of the system

profiles.question: Where the system holds its data, and how data moves in and out of OT: which side opens each transfer and what is on the path
must_show: Data stores and their zone
Data flows in and out of OT with the side that opens each one
Proxies, firewalls or scanning points on the path, or a marker where none is captured
Transfer tools and removable media
profiles.caption: Data stores and data flows in and out of OT

profiles.question: How administrative and SaaS access reaches the vital OT hosts
must_show: Jump hosts and gateways
Admin protocols used (RDP, RPC, SMB)
Any direct IT path
profiles.caption: Administrative access paths into OT

profiles.question: Where the vital hosts send their logs and monitoring data, and which side opens each connection
must_show: Log and monitoring collectors per host
Whether each collector is OT-resident or IT
profiles.caption: Log and monitoring data flows

profiles.question: Where the vital hosts get their patches
must_show: Patch / configuration management source per host
Whether it is OT-resident or IT
profiles.caption: Patch sources of the vital OT hosts

profiles.question: Where backups go, what runs them, and which side opens each backup connection
must_show: Backup agent and target per host
The data stores being backed up
Paths not captured
profiles.caption: Backup data flows of the vital OT hosts

profiles.question: Boundary devices and external exposure
must_show: Firewalls and proxies per boundary
Internet-facing hosts and flows
profiles.caption: Boundary protection and external exposure

profiles.question: Who manages the hypervisors that host the vital systems
must_show: Hypervisor and management hosts
The domain of the managing accounts
profiles.caption: Virtualisation management dependencies

profiles.question: How vendors reach the vital OT hosts
must_show: Vendor entry points
Gateways and jump hosts used
Any direct path
profiles.caption: Vendor access route

profiles.question: Outbound Internet and SMTP routes from the vital hosts, and whether they go through a proxy
must_show: Internet and SMTP flows per host
Proxy or direct
profiles.caption: Outbound Internet and mail routes

profiles.question: How failover and replication run
must_show: Replicas and listeners
Replication across sites, in order
profiles.caption: Failover and replication

profiles.question: How files move
must_show: Transfer steps in order
profiles.caption: File transfer steps

profiles.why: a plan and its thresholds; text and tables say it better
a process and its coverage; a table says it better
